title: Lemon Zucchini Orzo
author: Claude
description: Orzo cooked like a risotto with grated zucchini, lemon and parmesan. One pan.
steps: Fry the garlic in the olive oil for a minute, then toast the orzo in it for another minute.
Add the broth a ladle at a time, stirring, until the orzo is almost tender (about 10 minutes).
Stir in the zucchini and cook for 3 more minutes.
Off the heat, stir in the butter, parmesan, lemon zest and juice. Season and top with basil.
